# nextaibuilder — Agentic AI Engineer

> An in-person, cohort-based program in Sadiqabad, Punjab, Pakistan that trains
> builders to become Agentic AI Engineers. Available as a 6-month (accelerated)
> or 1-year (comprehensive) track, both covering the same curriculum: Python,
> LangChain, LangGraph, and n8n, ending in a capstone project where each
> student ships one real, deployed AI agent reviewed live by instructors.

## About

- Program name: Agentic AI Engineer
- Format: in-person, on-site studio (not a recorded or online-only course)
- Location: Plaza No. 11, Al-Haram City, Near New Bus Stand, Sadiqabad, Punjab, Pakistan
- Tracks: 6-month (accelerated) or 1-year (comprehensive, same curriculum spread over more time)
- Cohort size: small, by design, for direct instructor time
- Outcome: one real AI agent, designed and deployed by each student, reviewed live
- Price: PKR 15,000/month on both tracks. First 10 students get 20% off, PKR 12,000/month

## Curriculum (six steps, same order on both tracks)

1. Python for AI Engineers — Python fundamentals for AI work: environments, APIs, async code, calling LLMs directly
2. LangChain: Fundamentals — prompts, chains, memory, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
3. LangChain: In Production — tool calling, structured output, vector stores, evaluation
4. LangGraph — stateful, multi-step, multi-agent orchestration
5. n8n — workflow automation, webhooks, connecting agents to real tools and systems
6. Capstone: Ship Your Agent — one real, deployed AI agent, reviewed live by instructors

## Admissions

- Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; apply at https://sdk.nextaibuilder.com/#apply
- Process: apply, then a review, then admission with cohort dates and setup details
- This is the first cohort of the in-person Sadiqabad program
